# A place to begin

## Opening
We don't need a perfect plan to begin. We need a place to start, and someone willing to listen. This is not an effortless process. Small, deliberate steps can help us build trust.

## The proposal
The neighborhood reading room could open two evenings each week. The committee discussed the idea on September 12, but did not approve it. The proposed budget is $2,400. Jordan thinks six volunteers may be enough; that estimate is unconfirmed.

## Next steps
María will bring a revised schedule by October 3. Lee will ask about access to the building. No one has agreed to fund the project yet.

## Closing
Let's begin with one honest conversation. Listening carefully is already a useful first step.
